words.definition: A set of instructions used to solve a specific problem
words.definationTranslation: Kisi vishisht samasya ka samadhan karne ke liye upyog kiye jaane wale nirdeshon ka samuh

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used in the program helped to speed up the process.
sentence.translation: Program mein upyog kiya gaya algorithm prakriya ko tez karne mein madad karta hai.

sentence.sentence: The team developed a new algorithm to improve the efficiency of the system.
sentence.translation: Team ne pranaali ki kushalta mein sudhar ke liye ek naya algorithm viksit kiya.

words.definition: The quality of being complex or complicated
words.definationTranslation: Jatil ya samajhne mein mushkil hone ki gunvatta

sentence.sentence: The complexity of the problem made it difficult to solve.
sentence.translation: Samasya ki jatilta ke kaaran ise samajhna mushkil ho gaya.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm's complexity made it hard to understand and implement.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki jatilta ke kaaran ise samajhna aur lagu karna mushkil ho gaya.

words.definition: A notation used to describe the complexity of an algorithm
words.definationTranslation: Ek algorithm ki jatilta ka varnan karne ke liye upyog kiya jaane wala sanketon

sentence.sentence: The big-O notation is used to measure the worst-case scenario of an algorithm.
sentence.translation: Bada-O sanketon ka upyog algorithm ke sabse buri sthiti ka maap lene ke liye kiya jaata hai.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm has a big-O of n^2, making it inefficient for large inputs.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ka bada-O n^2 hai, jissey yeh bade input ke liye aprabhavi ho jaata hai.

words.definition: The amount of time an algorithm takes to complete
words.definationTranslation: Ek algorithm ko poora karne mein lagne wala samay

sentence.sentence: The time complexity of the algorithm is O(n log n).
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki samay jatilta O(n log n) hai.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm's time complexity makes it unsuitable for real-time applications.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki samay jatilta ke kaaran yeh vastavik samay ke prayog ke liye anuchit hai.

words.definition: The amount of memory an algorithm uses
words.definationTranslation: Ek algorithm dvara upyog kiya jaane wala smriti ki maatra

sentence.sentence: The space complexity of the algorithm is O(n).
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki staan jatilta O(n) hai.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm's space complexity makes it suitable for systems with limited memory.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki staan jatilta ke kaaran yeh seemit smriti wale pranaaliyon ke liye uchit hai.

words.definition: The quality of being efficient or effective
words.definationTranslation: Kushal ya prabhaavi hone ki gunvatta

sentence.sentence: The algorithm's efficiency is improved by reducing the number of iterations.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki kushalta ko avrittikon ki sankhya kam karke sudhaar ja sakta hai.

sentence.sentence: The efficiency of the system is measured by its ability to complete tasks quickly.
sentence.translation: Pranaali ki kushalta ko kaaryon ko jaldi poora karne ki kshamata se maapta jaata hai.

words.definition: The process of making something more efficient or effective
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ko adhik kushal ya prabhaavi banane ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The optimization of the algorithm improved its performance.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ka uttamikaran uski pradarshan ko sudhaar deta hai.

sentence.sentence: The team worked on optimization techniques to reduce the system's latency.
sentence.translation: Team ne pranaali ki vilambitata ko kam karne ke liye uttamikaran takneekon par kaam kiya.

words.definition: A situation where one thing is sacrificed for another
words.definationTranslation: Ek sthiti jahaan ek cheez doosri ke liye tyag di jaati hai

sentence.sentence: The trade-off between time and space complexity is a common challenge in algorithm design.
sentence.translation: Samay aur staan jatilta ke beech vyavhar algorithm design mein ek aam chunauti hai.

sentence.sentence: The team had to make a trade-off between efficiency and accuracy in their algorithm.
sentence.translation: Team ko apne algorithm mein kushalta aur satyata ke beech vyavhar karna pada.

words.definition: The ability of a system to handle increased load or demand
words.definationTranslation: Ek pranaali ki badh rahe bojh ya maang ko sambhalne ki kshamata

sentence.sentence: The scalability of the algorithm is critical for large-scale applications.
sentence.translation: Bade paimaane par prayog ke liye algorithm ki vristi aavashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: The team designed the system with scalability in mind to accommodate growing demand.
sentence.translation: Team ne badhti maang ko dhyan mein rakhte hue pranaali ka design kiya hai.

words.definition: The most unfavorable or difficult situation
words.definationTranslation: Sabse asahaj ya kathin sthiti

sentence.sentence: The worst-case scenario for the algorithm is when the input is extremely large.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ke liye sabse buri sthiti tab hoti hai jab input atyadhik bada hai.

sentence.sentence: The team prepared for the worst-case scenario by implementing backup systems.
sentence.translation: Team ne sabse buri sthiti ke liye taiyaari ki backup pranaaliyon ko lagu karke.

words.definition: The typical or expected situation
words.definationTranslation: Aam ya aashit sthiti

sentence.sentence: The average-case scenario for the algorithm is when the input is moderately sized.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ke liye aam sthiti tab hoti hai jab input madhyam aakaar ka hota hai.

sentence.sentence: The team optimized the algorithm for the average-case scenario to improve performance.
sentence.translation: Team ne aam sthiti ke liye algorithm ko uttamikrit kiya taaki pradarshan sudhar sake.

words.definition: The most favorable or easy situation
words.definationTranslation: Sabse anukul ya aasan sthiti

sentence.sentence: The best-case scenario for the algorithm is when the input is extremely small.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ke liye sabse achhi sthiti tab hoti hai jab input atyadhik chhota hai.

sentence.sentence: The team designed the algorithm to take advantage of the best-case scenario.
sentence.translation: Team ne algorithm ko sabse achhi sthiti ka laabh uthane ke liye design kiya.

words.definition: Relating to the behavior of a function as the input size approaches infinity
words.definationTranslation: Ek function ki vyavhar ka sandarbh jahan input ki maatra anant tak pahunchti hai

sentence.sentence: The asymptotic behavior of the algorithm is important for large inputs.
sentence.translation: Bade input ke liye algorithm ki aakarshak vyavhar mahatvapoorn hai.

sentence.sentence: The team studied the asymptotic analysis of the algorithm to understand its performance.
sentence.translation: Team ne algorithm ki aakarshak vishleshan kiya taaki uski pradarshan ko samajh sake.

words.definition: Composed of many different and connected parts
words.definationTranslation: Kai alag-alag aur judi hui bhagyon se milkar bani cheez

sentence.sentence: The complex algorithm required a lot of computational resources.
sentence.translation: Jatil algorithm ko bahut saari gananaatmak sansaadhanon ki aavashyakta thi.

sentence.sentence: The team struggled to understand the complex relationships between the variables.
sentence.translation: Team ko chhupaai sankriyaon ke beech jatil sambandhon ko samajhne mein kathinai hui.

words.definition: A method or technique that helps find a solution to a problem
words.definationTranslation: Ek vidhi ya takneek jo ek samasya ka samadhan dhoondhne mein madad karti hai

sentence.sentence: The heuristic algorithm provided a near-optimal solution to the problem.
sentence.translation: Anumaanit algorithm ne samasya ka lagbhag uttam samadhan pradaan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The team used a heuristic approach to solve the complex optimization problem.
sentence.translation: Team ne jatil uttamikaran samasya ko hal karne ke liye anumaanit drishtikon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: The process of repeating a function or procedure
words.definationTranslation: Ek function ya prakriya ko dohrane ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The recursion in the algorithm helped to solve the problem efficiently.
sentence.translation: Algorithm mein punaravrtti ne samasya ko kushalta se halne mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: The team used recursion to implement the tree traversal algorithm.
sentence.translation: Team ne vriksh parvaas algorithm ko lagu karne ke liye punaravrtti ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Characterized by constant change or progress
words.definationTranslation: Nirantar parivartan ya pragati ke dwara chinhit

sentence.sentence: The dynamic programming approach helped to solve the optimization problem.
sentence.translation: Gatishil programming drishtikon ne uttamikaran samasya ko halne mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: The team used dynamic algorithms to adapt to changing market conditions.
sentence.translation: Team ne badalte hue baajaar ki sthitiyon ke anusaar gatishil algorithm ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Making the locally optimal choice at each stage
words.definationTranslation: Pratyek charan par sthaaniya roop se uttam chunav karne wala

sentence.sentence: The greedy algorithm made the optimal choice at each step.
sentence.translation: Lalachhi algorithm ne pratyek charan par uttam chunav kiya.

sentence.sentence: The team used a greedy approach to solve the optimization problem.
sentence.translation: Team ne uttamikaran samasya ko halne ke liye lalachhi drishtikon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: A class of problems that are at least as hard as the hardest problems in NP
words.definationTranslation: Ek samasyaon ki shreni jo NP mein sabse kathin samasyaon se kam se kam utni hi kathin hai

sentence.sentence: The NP-complete problem was difficult to solve using traditional algorithms.
sentence.translation: NP-poorn samasya ko paramparagat algorithm ka upyog karke hal karna mushkil tha.

sentence.sentence: The team struggled to find an efficient solution to the NP-complete problem.
sentence.translation: Team ko NP-poorn samasya ke liye kushal samadhan dhoondhne mein kathinai hui.

words.definition: An approximate or rough calculation or estimate
words.definationTranslation: Ek anumaanit ya andaaza lagana

sentence.sentence: The approximation algorithm provided a close estimate of the optimal solution.
sentence.translation: Anumaan algorithm ne uttam samadhan ka andaaza lagaya.

sentence.sentence: The team used approximation techniques to solve the complex optimization problem.
sentence.translation: Team ne jatil uttamikaran samasya ko halne ke liye anumaan takneekon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: A mathematical expression consisting of variables and coefficients
words.definationTranslation: Chhapaavon aur gunaakon se milkar bani ganitiya abhivyakti

sentence.sentence: The polynomial time complexity of the algorithm made it efficient.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki bahupad samay jatilta ke kaaran yeh kushal tha.

sentence.sentence: The team used polynomial equations to model the complex system.
sentence.translation: Team ne jatil pranaali ko mudrit karne ke liye bahupad samikaranon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Increasing or growing at a rapid rate
words.definationTranslation: Tezi se badh raha ya vriddhi kar raha

sentence.sentence: The exponential growth of the algorithm's running time made it impractical.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ke chalne ka samay sanklan vriddhi ke kaaran yeh avyavahaarik ho gaya.

sentence.sentence: The team struggled to optimize the exponential time complexity of the algorithm.
sentence.translation: Team ko algorithm ki sanklan samay jatilta ko uttamikrit karne mein kathinai hui.

words.definition: Relating to or resembling a logarithm
words.definationTranslation: Logariddh par sambandhit ya usi jaisa

sentence.sentence: The logarithmic time complexity of the algorithm made it efficient.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki logariddhmiya samay jatilta ke kaaran yeh kushal tha.

sentence.sentence: The team used logarithmic functions to analyze the system's performance.
sentence.translation: Team ne pranaali ki pradarshan ka vishleshan karne ke liye logariddhmiya karyaon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Relating to or resembling a line
words.definationTranslation: Rekha par sambandhit ya usi jaisa

sentence.sentence: The linear time complexity of the algorithm made it efficient.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki rekhiya samay jatilta ke kaaran yeh kushal tha.

sentence.sentence: The team used linear equations to model the system's behavior.
sentence.translation: Team ne pranaali ke vyavhar ko mudrit karne ke liye rekhiya samikaranon ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Relating to or resembling a square or a quadratic equation
words.definationTranslation: Varg par sambandhit ya usi jaisa

sentence.sentence: The quadratic time complexity of the algorithm made it inefficient.
sentence.translation: Algorithm ki vargapurn samay jatilta ke kaaran yeh aprabhavi tha.

sentence.sentence: The team struggled to optimize the quadratic time complexity of the algorithm.
sentence.translation: Team ko algorithm ki vargapurn samay jatilta ko uttamikrit karne mein kathinai hui.
